## Interpretation limits

The small history is 320 facts /10 commits; wide is 256 rows ×8 cells /1,024 float cells, not 1,024 stored facts. CPU affinity is not isolation. Statement assignment can dispose the previous result before stop; external normalization follows it. Intervals are descriptive per-control, not family-wise/equivalence guarantees. Profiles are distorted overlapping diagnostics, not subtractable causes. The 5%/CI/both-round investigation screen is not the original functional item-2 Done-when or a universal release SLO. Counts overlap, not certification. Exact-host unstable C API v2 remains pinned; no stabilization date or production-readiness claim. No Codex, user-computer action, merge, deployment, force-push or GitHub deletion.
